# Deluxe Accelerates Payments Integrations from Weeks to Hours


November 19, 2026 3:45 pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_daf1e6315e05b07b26e41e2bd7df07d0/deluxe/news/2026-11-19_Deluxe_Accelerates_Payments_Integrations_from_485.pdf)


*Enhancements to the Deluxe developer portal deliver AI-agent-ready APIs for faster payments integration and innovation*


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**Deluxe Corporation (NYSE: DLX),** a trusted payments and data company, today announced the launch of new tools to help software engineers using the[developer.deluxe.com](https://developer.deluxe.com/) portal to integrate with the Deluxe payments system faster than ever.


The upgraded portal provides several key capabilities to the millions of merchants, including retailers and service companies, for which Deluxe processes payments:


- Model Context Protocol (MCP) access, agent instructions, and tested prompts for AI development tools – including GitHub Copilot, Anthropic's Claude, OpenAI Codex, and Anysphere’s Cursor – work directly with Deluxe APIs and documentation.
- Enhanced, machine-readable API specifications and technical guidance help developers and AI agents discover relevant payment capabilities, identify integration requirements, and generate implementation code to expedite launch.
- An interactive sandbox demo, available with try-it-now features, along with embedded search-and-query AI functions **.**
- Secure authentication, access management, and implementation best practices help partners build resilient payment experiences.


“Work that once took engineers weeks can now be completed in hours, and AI agents can handle much of the integration,” said Kevin Jones, who is president of Deluxe Merchant Services, the division of Deluxe that supports transactions at millions of businesses, including retailers and service companies. “That is the kind of practical innovation that helps our software partners bring new digital commerce experiences to market faster.”


The upgrades build on the Deluxe Payments Platform (DPP), an API-first foundation for embedded payments and AI-enabled innovation. The enhanced developer experience helps software providers integrate Deluxe payment capabilities more efficiently, supporting faster development and deployment of new payment experiences.


**About Deluxe**


Deluxe, a trusted payments and data company, champions business so communities thrive. Our solutions help businesses pay, get paid, and grow. For more than 100 years, Deluxe customers have relied on our solutions and platforms at all stages of their lifecycle, from start-up to maturity. Our powerful scale supports millions of small businesses, thousands of vital financial institutions and hundreds of the world’s largest consumer brands, while processing more than $2 trillion in annual payment volume. Our reach, scale, and distribution channels position Deluxe to be our customers’ most trusted business partner.
